owner_observations: The exact cue WAV is audible when played through VLC.
The exact cue is not audible through ffmpeg's AudioToolbox output muxer even after the output-device mapping was corrected.

apple_api_semantics.audio_queue_dispose_false: Defer disposal until all enqueued buffers are processed.

root_cause: The ffmpeg AudioToolbox output muxer accepts and enqueues the 100 ms cue, then reaches EOF and immediately flushes/disposes the queue without proving that the short buffers reached audible hardware output.
candidate_successor_fixes: Pace input in real time so the queue remains alive through the cue and settle interval.
Use a playback API that exposes completion/drain confirmation before disposal.
reason_change_is_forbidden: Playback implementation and live route behavior were frozen before the first cohort session and cannot change after session results.
claim_boundary: Playback-drain root-cause record. It does not authorize a workaround, modify V1, validate a successor implementation, rewrite prior statuses, or support a product claim.
